risk_register.mitigation: Lucy & Yak will review and update their governance compliance policies to align with the latest regulatory requirements, considering their current score of 6.46.

risk_register.label: Staff adoption risk
risk_register.trigger_reason: staff_digital_literacy final_score=7.22 vs thresholds HIGH<4.0 MEDIUM<6.0
risk_register.mitigation: Lucy & Yak will provide ongoing digital literacy training for staff to maintain a high adoption rate, leveraging their existing score of 7.22 as a benchmark.

Owner-manager resistance is the single strongest predictor of failed AI adoption in fashion SMEs

risk_register.label: Vendor dependency risk

risk_register.regulatory_ref: Data (Use and Access) Act 2025 — data portability provisions

Single marketing automation vendor lock-in — if Klaviyo is the only tool, all customer communication is at risk from a single vendor decision

risk_register.label: AI accuracy and hallucination risk
risk_register.mitigation: Lucy & Yak will implement AI model explainability features in their chat widget, if integrated, to mitigate potential hallucinations and maintain brand transparency.
risk_register.regulatory_ref: UK AI Bill 2026 — accuracy and transparency obligations
fashion_extensions_applied: AI-generated size advice that is wrong drives returns rather than reducing them — directly counterproductive to the primary use case
AI-generated product descriptions containing incorrect material composition create trading standards liability

risk_register.label: Ethical and bias risk
risk_register.mitigation: Lucy & Yak will review and update their privacy policy to explicitly address AI usage and data collection practices, considering their existing mention of AI in the policy.
risk_register.regulatory_ref: UK Equality Act 2010 — protected characteristics in automated decision-making
fashion_extensions_applied: Sizing bias — AI sizing recommendations trained primarily on standard UK size data may underserve plus-size, petite or non-standard body types who represent a majority of real customers
Fast-fashion sustainability — AI demand forecasting optimised purely for sell-through rate may conflict with the business's sustainability commitments or consumer expectations around overconsumption

roi_summary: Lucy & Yak can expect significant commercial benefits from implementing the full roadmap within 12 weeks. Automated Review Collection (Phase 1) will start generating more reviews, improving customer trust and increasing sales. Returns Reason Capture (Phase 1) will help identify areas for improvement in their returns process. Email Marketing Automation Flows (Phases 2-3) will optimize email campaigns, driving higher returns on marketing spend. Size Guide Chatbot (Phase 3) and WhatsApp Styling Assistant (Phase 4) will enhance customer experience, reducing size-related returns and increasing sales conversions. AI Demand Forecasting (Phase 8) and Dynamic Pricing Engine (Phase 8) will improve inventory management and pricing strategies, respectively.
